payload.name: Trellis Law
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Direct access to the US state trial court system, enabling legal research and insights on cases, verdicts, judges, attorneys, motions, litigation trends, and more - all grounded and sourced from trial court data and documents.
payload.longDescription: 直接访问美国州审判法院系统,允许对案件,判决,法官,律师,动议,诉讼趋势等的法律研究和见解 - 所有这些都是基于和来源于审判法院数据和文件。

payload.name: CData Connect AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
payload.longDescription: Connect AI 与云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖泊、分析平台等一起工作,以便您可以通过对话探索和分析数据。 使用您的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入,例如将产品远程测量与发布时间表相关联,以调查用户参与度。 在 Connect AI 中,您可以构建具有定义关系和语义背景的源头上的虚拟数据集,并将其表面化为有目的的工具 – 因此,ChatGPT 以您的业务理解的方式与您的数据合作,而不仅仅是存储的方式。

payload.name: MotherDuck
payload.description: 从您的数据中获得答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.
payload.longDescription: 将AI助理连接到您的MotherDuck数据仓库,使用自然语言探索、可视化和管理数据,无需 SQL 技能。创建Dives:交互式可视化,允许您与您的团队保存和共享答案,同时保持最新数据的最新状态。

payload.name: StatsHawk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minutes of box scores posting.

Beyond the basics: MLB pitch-by-pitch with Statcast detail (pitch type, velocity, launch data, filterable to a batter-pitcher matchup) and pre-computed player prop analysis, season, recent, and home/away averages with hit rates against any line, built for fantasy research, start/sit calls, and matchup prep.

Sign in with a free StatsHawk account when you connect; no API key to manage. Free includes 5,000 usage credits monthly and every standard stat tool. Prop analysis comes with paid plans.
payload.longDescription:
StatsHawk 提供 ChatGPT 的真实、当前的体育数据,而不是从训练数据中获得的猜测。 询问任何比赛,并获得 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA篮球和足球以及包括英超联盟在内的主要足球比赛的得分、日程表、排名、票房得分、列表和球员搜索,所有这些都被规范成一个一致的形状,数字在票房得分发布后几分钟内降落。

超越基本:MLB球场比球场与Statcast细节(球场类型,速度,发射数据,可过滤到球场比球)和预先计算的球员支持分析,季节,最近和家 / 外的平均值与对任何线的打击率,用于幻想研究,开始 / 坐位呼叫和比赛准备。

连接时使用免费的 StatsHawk 帐户登录;没有管理的 API 密钥. 免费包含每月 5,000 个使用信贷和每个标准的 stat 工具。

payload.name: GIS Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries. 

This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and organize maps and layers
- Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
- Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
- Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
- Import files and manage datasets
- Generate reports from your geospatial data

You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.
payload.longDescription:
GIS云是一个云地理空间平台,由60多个国家的政府、公用事业和实地团队使用。

该应用程序允许您以简单的语言与GIS云帐户合作,没有GIS专业知识或单击所需的菜单。

请 ChatGPT 构建和编辑地图,创建和样式层,添加或查询功能,运行空间分析,为现场团队设计移动数据收集表单,导入数据集,并生成报告。

您可以做的是: - 创建,更新和组织地图和层 - 添加,编辑和查询功能和属性数据 - 运行空间分析和计算统计数据 - 构建和管理移动数据收集表单的现场团队 - 导入文件和管理数据集 - 从您的地理空间数据生成报告

您保持控制权. GIS Cloud 使用一个提出和确认模型:在任何东西被写入您的帐户之前提出更改,并明确标记破坏性行为。

与您现有的 GIS 云帐户一起工作. 新进入 GIS 云? 免费在 giscloud.com 注册。

payload.name: Powerset Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) is a technical journal from Powerset (https://powerset.co/) where we analyze tech trends, publish analytics, and provide free tools for helping founders. This app allows anyone to access the data underlying Powerset Research via ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/)是来自Powerset(https://powerset.co/)的技术日志,我们分析技术趋势,发布分析,并提供免费的工具来帮助创始人。

payload.name: Similarweb
payload.description: 网站,应用程序,搜索和市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research any website or app inside ChatGPT using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts. Ask things like "Show me Nike's traffic sources breakdown" or "What keywords is Adidas ranking for?" and get real-time insights without switching tools. Whether you're a marketer, analyst, investor, or strategist, Similarweb helps you turn competitive questions into answers instantly.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Similarweb 的市场情报数据,研究 ChatGPT 中的任何网站或应用程序,分析竞争对手的流量,发现顶尖的关键字,探索受众人口统计,并通过简单的提示来衡量业绩。询问“显示我耐克的流量来源分布”或“什么关键字是阿迪达斯排名?”等问题,并获得无需切换工具的实时见解。

payload.name: Kwater
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Official real-time water data service by K-water (Korea Water Resources Corporation). Ask about dam storage levels, inflow/discharge, river water levels, rainfall, and water quality across South Korea's dams and rivers — updated every 10 minutes.
payload.longDescription: 由K-water(韩国水资源公司)提供的官方实时水数据服务:询问南韩水坝和河流的储存水平、涌入/排水量、河流水位、降雨量和水质 - 每10分钟更新一次。

payload.name: Metorik
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chat with your Shopify or WooCommerce sales data directly in ChatGPT. Ask questions like "Where do our most profitable customers come from?" or "Which products are trending this quarter?" and get real-time answers pulled straight from your store.

Dig into revenue, products, customers, and channels, or ask for a growth strategy built on your actual historical data. Works with one store or many, with every metric generated in real-time.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接使用 Shopify 或 WooCommerce 销售数据聊天,询问“我们最赚钱的客户来自哪里?”或“本季度哪些产品处于潮流?”等问题,并从您的商店获得实时答案。

挖掘收入,产品,客户和渠道,或要求建立在您的实际历史数据的基础上的增长策略。

payload.name: Porter Metrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Porter brings your marketing and ecommerce data into ChatGPT. Connect accounts from Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, GA4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other supported platforms in Porter, then ask questions in plain English — "Which campaigns drove the most revenue last week?", "How did spend compare across channels yesterday?" — and get answers pulled live from your authorized accounts.

Compare performance across platforms using unified metrics like clicks and spend, even when the underlying numbers come from different sources.

When you need the data outside the chat, schedule recurring exports of any query to a BigQuery table — Porter handles the cron and the schema, so your dashboards and warehouse stay in sync.
payload.longDescription:
Porter 将您的营销和电子商务数据带入 ChatGPT. 在 Porter 中连接来自 Facebook Ads、Google Ads、Shopify、GA4、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和其他受支持的平台的帐户,然后用简单的英语提问 - “上周哪些活动带来了最多的收入?”, “昨天如何花费在不同渠道进行比较?” - 并从您的授权帐户获得实时回复。

使用单一指标(如点击和花费)比较跨平台的性能,即使基础数字来自不同来源。

当您需要在聊天之外的数据时,请计划将任何查询重复导出到 BigQuery 表 - Porter 处理 cron 和架构,以便您的仪表板和仓库保持同步。

payload.name: SkyWatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and explore satellite imagery from top providers including Vantor, Planet, Airbus, and more, all in one place. SkyWatch lets you find archive imagery by location, date, resolution, and cloud cover, compare pricing across providers, and browse available satellites and product offerings. Results include direct links to view and order imagery on SkyWatch Explore.
payload.longDescription: 搜索和探索来自顶级供应商的卫星图像,包括Vantor,Planet,Airbus等,在一个地方。SkyWatch允许您根据位置,日期,分辨率和云覆盖率找到档案图像,比较各供应商的价格,并浏览可用的卫星和产品报价。

payload.name: GSC SEO & Content Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Google Search Console to analyze finalized search performance, uncover keyword and content opportunities, compare ranking changes, and plan SEO articles using data from the SMEPost organizations you authorize. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot edit content, publish, or write to Google Search Console.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Google Search Console 来分析最终的搜索性能,发现关键字和内容机会,比较排名变化,并使用您授权的 SMEPost 组织的数据计划 SEO 文章。

payload.name: Brand & Market Social Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search recent public social posts for brand mentions, market demand, customer feedback, product needs, and emerging trends using keywords, language filters, and exclusions. Each request runs a bounded on-demand search and returns minimized JSON. It never accesses private posts, tracks people by identity, or runs continuously. Brand & Market Social Research is an independent Telemark Digital app. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.
payload.longDescription: 搜索最近的公共社交帖子以获取品牌提及、市场需求、客户反馈、产品需求和新兴趋势,使用关键字、语言过滤器和排除。每个请求都会运行有限的按需搜索,并返回最小化的 JSON。它永远不会访问私人帖子,不会根据身份跟踪用户,也不会连续运行。品牌和市场社会研究是一款独立的Telemark Digital应用程序。不需要外部帐户、支付方式或购买。

payload.name: Ramp Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ramp Data MCP enables ChatGPT users to access Ramp Data from billions of dollars in real corporate spend across 50,000+ businesses, including Ramp Rate (vendor adoption, pricing, and switching trends) and the AI Index (how businesses are spending on AI). Ramp Data is used by founders, procurement leads, researchers, investors, and policy analysts and is cited by leading publications like NYT, WSJ, Bloomberg, and more.
payload.longDescription: Ramp Data MCP 允许 ChatGPT 用户从 50,000 多家企业中获得数十亿美元的真实企业支出,包括 Ramp Rate (供应商采纳、定价和切换趋势) 和 AI Index (企业如何花在 AI 上)。

payload.name: BigGeo AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BigGeo AI brings spatial intelligence into your chat, allowing you to ask questions and get answers powered by real-world location data. Instead of searching through maps or raw data, simply ask and get clear, relevant answers about locations and how they relate.
payload.longDescription: BigGeo AI将空间智能带入您的聊天中,允许您提出问题并获得由真实世界位置数据驱动的答案,而不是通过地图或原始数据搜索,只需询问并获得有关位置和它们如何关系的明确、相关的答案。

payload.name: Leo - Running Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leo is a running coach you talk to. Connect your Strava or Suunto account once, and Leo builds a periodized training plan around your goal race, then adapts it week after week based on your completed workouts and how you feel — no extra sensors needed.

Ask Leo to review your last run, adjust this week's sessions around your schedule, estimate your race time, or explain the reasoning behind a workout. Every recommendation is grounded in peer-reviewed sports science, and Leo remembers your training history, so its coaching stays consistent over time.

Requires a Coach Leo account (coachleo.ai). Your training data stays in your account and is only used to coach you.
payload.longDescription:
连接你的Strava或Suunto帐户一次,然后Leo在你的目标比赛周围建立一个周期化的训练计划,然后根据完成的训练和你的感受每周调整它 - 无需额外的传感器。

请Leo审查你的最后一场比赛,调整本周的课程,估计你的比赛时间,或解释锻炼背后的推理。

需要一个 Coach Leo 帐户(coachleo.ai)。您的培训数据保留在您的帐户中,仅用于训练您。

payload.name: Minter.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Minter.io helps users inspect connected social media reports, discover available analytics metrics, and query report data from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Threads through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Minter.io帮助用户检查连接的社交媒体报告,发现可用的分析指标,并通过ChatGPT查询Instagram,TikTok,X,Facebook,LinkedIn和Threads的报告数据。

payload.name: Omni
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omni lets users work with their organization's governed business intelligence data from ChatGPT. The app can list available Omni models, select the best topic for a question, generate and run a single analytical query, start Omni's full AI assistant for deeper multi-step analysis, check the assistant job status, and search Omni documentation.
payload.longDescription: Omni 允许用户从 ChatGPT 管理业务情报数据工作,该应用程序可以列出可用的 Omni 模型,选择一个问题的最佳主题,生成并运行单个分析查询,启动 Omni 的完整 AI 助理以进行更深入的多步分析,检查助理工作状态,并搜索 Omni 文档。

payload.name: Amplitude EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 将 Amplitude 工作区连接到搜索图表和仪表板、查询指标和实验结果,探索事件和属性,创建或更新图表,仪表板和警报,而不会离开对话。

payload.name: Sixtyfour Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Deploy AI agents that investigate people and companies, resolve identities, map relationships, and surface risk signals — all through a single API.
payload.longDescription: 部署AI代理,调查人员和公司,解决身份,地图关系和表面风险信号 - 所有这些都通过一个API。

payload.name: Atlan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect ChatGPT to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, so every question you ask ChatGPT is grounded in trusted organisational context.
payload.longDescription: Atlan 是企业 AI 的背景层。 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的组织的背景 repos:您的 AI 代理需要准确地回答的知识、数据和语义。 使用 Atlan 的代理技能来搜索和发现企业背景,跨越端到端的线路,访问受管制的数据定义和词汇,执行 SQL,编辑您的元数据图,并确保数据质量,因此您询问的每个问题都建立在可信的组织环境中。

payload.name: JoomPulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse. Whether you're doing competitive research, category analysis, or tracking listing performance, JoomPulse translates your questions into precise data insights without writing a single line of SQL. Built for e-commerce teams and analysts who need fast, reliable answers from Brazil's largest online marketplace.
payload.longDescription: JoomPulse 可以通过自然语言查询立即访问 MercadoLivre 巴西的市场数据,分析产品列表、类别、销售人员、定价趋势、评论和关键字 - 所有这些都是由结构化数据仓库驱动的 - 无论您是进行竞争性研究、类别分析还是跟踪列表性能,JoomPulse 都会将您的问题转化为准确的数据洞察,而无需写单行 SQL。

payload.name: Book Report
payload.description: 分析您的作者销售数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book Report imports and organizes your sales data from Kindle Direct Publishing, Draft2Digital, and many more leading book publishing platforms. With this app, you can give ChatGPT access to that sales data. It can summarize trends, compare time periods, identify top books and series, break down earnings by distributor or marketplace, answer follow-up questions, and much more. Instead of clicking around to find the data you need, you can get it simply by asking. Access is read-only: the app can retrieve reports and catalog context, but cannot modify Book Report data, accounts, or connected publishing accounts.
payload.longDescription: 书籍报告从Kindle Direct Publishing、Draft2Digital和许多其他领先的书籍出版平台中导入和组织您的销售数据. 通过这个应用程序,您可以让ChatGPT访问这些销售数据。 它可以总结趋势,比较时间段,识别顶级书籍和系列,按经销商或市场分割收入,回答后续问题,等等。 相反,您可以通过简单的询问来查找所需的数据。 访问仅限阅读:该应用程序可以检索报告和目录背景,但不能修改书籍报告数据、帐户或相关的出版账户。

payload.name: ChartMogul
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChartMogul’s MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your subscription analytics and customer data. Analyze MRR, ARR, churn, retention, cohorts, subscriptions, revenue trends, and customer activity using natural language. Investigate business performance, identify growth opportunities, uncover churn drivers, explore customer relationships, and answer complex questions about your SaaS business. Built for founders and go-to-market, product, and finance teams, it turns ChartMogul data into actionable insights and faster decisions.
payload.longDescription: ChartMogul 的 MCP 服务器为 AI 助理提供安全访问您的订阅分析和客户数据。分析 MRR、ARR、churn、 retention、cohorts、订阅、收入趋势和客户活动,使用自然语言进行业务调查,识别增长机会,发现可行的驱动因素,探索客户关系,并回答有关您的 SaaS 业务的复杂问题。为创始人和市场、产品和金融团队构建,它将 ChartMogul 数据变成可操作的见解和更快的决策。

payload.name: Deepnote
payload.description: 与代理商运行数据工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Deepnote workspace into Codex. Search your workspace, trigger analytical workflows across 60+ data connectors, and use the output in Codex. No SQL, R, or Python knowledge required with the help of OpenAI models.

With Deepnote MCP, you can:

- Search across your projects, notebooks, and integrations
- Run an end-to-end notebook
- Pull the latest result from the notebook runs
- See scheduled runs in the workspace

All this while respecting your Deepnote workspace’s permissions. Note: this MCP requires an active Deepnote account and a Deepnote API token (https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api).
payload.longDescription:
将您的 Deepnote 工作区带入 Codex. 搜索您的工作区,在 60 多个数据连接器中启动分析工作流程,并使用 Codex 中的输出。

使用Deepnote MCP,您可以:

- 搜索您的项目,笔记本和集成 - 运行端到端笔记本 - 从笔记本运行中提取最新结果 - 查看工作区的计划运行

注意:此 MCP 需要一个活跃的 Deepnote 帐户和一个 Deepnote API 代码(https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api)。

payload.name: PagePulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics.
The unique angle is correlation. PagePulse tracks every detected change to your pages — title rewrites, content updates, schema edits, link changes — and scores each one by importance. So when you ask "why did traffic drop on the pricing page last week?", ChatGPT can pull the analytics, surface the relevant page changes, and show you which edits lined up with the shift.
Use it to investigate traffic dips, audit what's been changing across your site, find the queries driving impressions to a specific page, browse pages by tag, or get a quick read on how a project is performing — without switching between dashboards.
payload.longDescription: PagePulse 将您的 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标和页面上检测的变更历史记录带入 ChatGPT. 按项目、页面或主题询问您的网站,并在您的实际分析中获得答案。 独特的角度是相关性。 PagePulse 追踪您页面的每一个检测变更 - 标题重写,内容更新,方案编辑,链接变更 - 并按重要性评分。 因此,当您问“为什么上周的定价页面上的流量下降?”时,ChatGPT 可以抽取分析,表面上显示相关的页面变更,并向您展示与变更相符的编辑。 使用它来调查流量下降,审核您网站上的变化,找到引导到特定页面的查询,按标签浏

payload.name: InsightfulPipe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

payload.name: Evidence Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets ChatGPT work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

After you connect your Evidence account, ChatGPT can:
- Browse table metadata
- Run read-only queries against data stored in Evidence
- Search your published reports by topic, metric, or term, and read a page's content or a structured summary of its queries and components
- Retrieve AI context stored in Evidence - so answers match how your organization reports
payload.longDescription:
Evidence 是一个 AI 驱动的 BI 工具,用于使用 SQL 和 Markdown 发布报告. 该连接器允许 ChatGPT 以您的名义使用组织的实时数据和发布报告 - 安全,并以您的权限为范围。

连接到您的 Evidence 帐户后,ChatGPT 可以: - 浏览表元数据 - 对存储在 Evidence 中的数据运行只读查询 - 根据主题,指标或术语搜索发布的报告,并阅读页面的内容或其查询和组件的结构性摘要 - 检索存储在 Evidence 中的 AI 背景 - 以便答案匹配您的组织报告的方式

payload.name: Temso
payload.description: 在AI聊天中跟踪您的品牌
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI chats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Temso tracks your brand's visibility across AI assistants — share of voice, sentiment, which sources they cite, and recommended actions to improve. Connect Temso to ask about your AI-visibility data in natural language and pull live analytics straight into the chat.
payload.longDescription: Temso 在 AI 助理中追踪您的品牌可见性 - 分享您的声音,情绪,他们引用的来源,并建议采取措施来改进。

payload.name: Windsock
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.
payload.longDescription: Windsock估计一般航空飞机的市场价值,并提供该估计背后的支持性市场数据。输入飞机的尾号(N号)以获取估计的当前市场价值,可比较的飞机,以及该制造和型号的最近的价格趋势。您可以用简单的语言询问后续问题 - 飞机学,发动机修理时间,损坏历史或位置影响价值;相似的飞机通常需要多久才能出售;以及更广泛的领域是如何移动的。 Windsock还提取了FAA注册详细信息,飞行能力指令,以及机场级信息,包括当前的天气和燃料价格预测。它是为飞机所有者,买家,卖家,经纪人和任何需要辩护阅读的飞机价值和其市场行为的人而建造的。

payload.name: DMAP AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DMAP AI helps users analyze drought conditions for a selected location and time period. It returns SPI tables, drought severity events, wavelet scalogram summaries, and drought periodicity diagnostics using NASA POWER or ERA5 data. Copula and paid workflows are not included in this ChatGPT version.
payload.longDescription: DMAP AI 可帮助用户分析所选地点和时间段的干旱条件,返回 SPI 表、干旱严重性事件、 wavelet scalogram 摘要以及使用 NASA POWER 或 ERA5 数据进行干旱周期性诊断。

payload.name: DC PASS Contracts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This app allows searching the 50,000 contracts awarded by the District of Columbia government since 2015.
payload.longDescription: 该应用程序可以搜索自2015年以来哥伦比亚区政府颁发的5万份合同。

payload.name: Trace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trace gives agents structured data on what technologies companies use, who they partner with, and who they're hiring. Ask about any company's tech stack, integration ecosystem, or recent hiring signals, and Trace returns structured answers. Create lists to monitor changes over time. Useful for account research, market analysis, competitive insights, or spotting when a company adopts a new tool or partner.
payload.longDescription: Trace 提供代理商的结构化数据,说明公司使用哪些技术,他们与谁合作,以及他们正在招聘谁. 询问任何公司的技术堆栈,整合生态系统或最近的招聘信号,然后 Trace 返回结构化答案。

payload.name: Amplifyr
payload.description: 品牌 AI 可见性代理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Amplifyr gives ChatGPT direct access to your brand's AI visibility analytics. Ask in plain English and get instant answers on share of voice, industry rankings, KPIs, citations, sentiment, and the questions people are asking about brands like yours across AI models. Data is scoped to your organisation only. No SQL. No dashboards. Just ask.
payload.longDescription: Amplifyr 让 ChatGPT 直接访问您的品牌的 AI 可见性分析。用简单的英语询问,并获得关于语音份额、行业排名、KPIs、引用、情绪以及人们在 AI 模型中询问您喜欢的品牌的问题的即时答案。

payload.name: Centiment
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and analyze your Centiment organizations, workspaces, surveys, and survey responses directly from ChatGPT. The Centiment MCP Server provides secure, read-only access to survey data you already have permission to view, making it easy to discover surveys, inspect responses, and summarize findings without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 直接从 ChatGPT 浏览和分析您的 Centiment 组织、工作区、调查和调查响应. Centiment MCP 服务器提供安全、只读的访问到您已授权查看的调查数据,使您很容易发现调查、检查回复和总结结果,而不离开 ChatGPT。

payload.name: Winnow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Winnow helps growers answer questions about their own farm operations in ChatGPT. The app exposes schema discovery and read-only SQL query tools over the farm's scoped operation, field, and weather tables, with server-side validation that rejects non-SELECT statements and out-of-scope datasets.
payload.longDescription: Winnow 帮助种植者在 ChatGPT 中回答有关他们自己的农场操作的问题. 该应用程序在农场的范围操作、场景和天气表中暴露了方案发现和只读的 SQL 查询工具,并通过服务器侧验证拒绝非 SELECT 陈述和范围外的数据集。

payload.name: Enterpret
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enterpret helps teams understand what customers are saying across support tickets, sales calls, app reviews, surveys, Slack, and more. Ask natural-language questions to find complaint trends, feature requests, segment-specific patterns, and direct customer quotes. Results are grounded in your customer context graph and include links back to source records so product, GTM, and leadership teams can act with context.
payload.longDescription: Enterpret 帮助团队了解客户在支持票、销售电话、应用评论、调查、Slack 等方面所说的内容。 提出自然语言问题,以查找投诉趋势、功能请求、特定领域的模式和直接的客户报价。

payload.name: Azadea One
payload.description: 管理 Azadea BI 洞察力
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Azadea One gives approved business users read-only aggregate insights across performance marketing, CRM, ecommerce, physical stores, ecommerce operations, Customer Analytics, and marketing budgets. OAuth and hub permissions enforce access. It never exposes raw SQL, raw tables, credentials, customer identifiers, or write actions.
payload.longDescription: Azadea One 提供经批准的商业用户在性能营销、CRM、电子商务、实体商店、电子商务运营、客户分析和营销预算上仅可读的综合见解。

payload.name: Datadog Experiments
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin is the best way to agentically interact with Datadog Product Analytics, Feature Flagging, and Experimentation
payload.longDescription: 此插件是与Datadog产品分析、功能旗帜和实验进行代理互动的最佳方式

payload.name: Appskyline
payload.description: 跟踪 App Store 排名
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask questions about the mobile apps you track in Appskyline. Review store identities, tracked keywords, and current iOS App Store, Google Play, and Microsoft Store rankings without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 询问有关您在 Appskyline 中追踪的移动应用程序的问题. 查看商店身份、追踪的关键字以及当前的 iOS App Store、Google Play 和 Microsoft Store 排名,而不离开 ChatGPT。

payload.name: Remedy Legal
payload.description: 查找英国法律住房数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Type a UK postcode to explore legal housing-related information on a clear, interactive map. 

See local HMO licensing schemes, nearby advice centres, tribunal decisions, and councillors for the area, then filter to what matters most and tap markers for quick details. 

Open source links where available for deeper context. This is an informational overview, not legal advice.
payload.longDescription:
输入英国邮政代码,在清晰、交互式地图上探索法律住房相关信息。

查看本地HMO许可计划,附近的咨询中心,法院裁决和该地区的议员,然后过滤至最重要的内容,并点击标记以获取快速细节。

开放源代码链接可用于更深入的背景,这是一个信息性概述,而不是法律建议。

payload.name: Extract
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract helps teams inspect data connectors and pipeline health, configure sources and destinations, manage connection schedules and streams, review run history, troubleshoot failures, and start approved manual runs.
payload.longDescription: 提取可以帮助团队检查数据连接器和管道健康,配置源和目的地,管理连接时间表和流程,查看运行历史记录,解决故障,并启动批准的手动运行。

payload.name: Formester
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read and analyze form submissions through ChatGPT. Search submissions with natural language, filter by date or status, and get AI-generated insights like sentiment, categories, and summaries and saved back as custom fields. Process file attachments including PDFs and images. Works with any form built on Formester.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT阅读和分析表单提交。使用自然语言搜索提交,按日期或状态过滤,并获得人工智能生成的见解,如情绪,类别和摘要,并将其保存为自定义字段。

payload.name: Carbon Arc
payload.description: 查询数据并构建洞察力
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Carbon Arc MCP Server is a business intelligence platform that converts natural language questions into insights for decision-making by providing access to private data.

Core Functions:

1. Ask questions like "Show me Walmart's 2024 card spend" and get structured data tables
2. Search for companies, locations, and metrics by name based on available data
3. Analyze trends across different time periods and geographic regions
4. Explore relationships between entities and available data
payload.longDescription:
Carbon Arc MCP 服务器是一个商业智能平台,通过提供访问私人数据,将自然语言问题转化为决策的见解。

核心功能:

1. 询问问题,如“向我展示沃尔玛的2024卡支出”,并获得结构化数据表 2. 根据可用的数据搜索公司,地点和指标的名称 3. 分析不同时间段和地理区域的趋势 4. 探索实体之间的关系和可用的数据

payload.name: SEO Programático
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Consultá en lenguaje natural cómo está funcionando tu sitio.

Visualizá visitantes, sesiones, páginas principales, conversiones y calidad del tráfico, distinguiendo personas, crawlers de IA y bots comunes.

Cada usuario accede únicamente a los datos agregados de los sitios vinculados a su cuenta.
payload.longDescription:
查看您的网站如何运作的自然语言

可查看访问者,会话,主要页面,转换和交通质量,区分人员,人工智能探测器和常规机器人。

每个用户只能访问与其帐户相关的网站的数据。

payload.name: AirOps
payload.description: Craft 内容. 赢得 AI 搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your AirOps workspaces, Brand Kits, and AEO (AI Engine Optimization) analytics directly through ChatGPT. Monitor your brand's performance in AI search results, analyze citation rates, and optimize your content strategy.

You can use AirOps to:

Brand Performance Analysis:
"Show me my brand's citation rate and share of voice for the last 30 days"

Content Optimization:

"What are the top questions citing my website and how can I improve my answers?"

Competitive Intelligence:

"Compare my brand's AI search performance against my top 3 competitors"

Use your Brand Kit to create content: 

"Write a blog post about the product described in the attached document"
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 直接访问您的 AirOps 工作区、品牌套件和 AEO (AI Engine Optimization) 分析,监控您的品牌在 AI 搜索结果中的表现,分析引用率,并优化您的内容策略。

您可以使用 AirOps 来:

品牌绩效分析:“在过去 30 天内显示我的品牌引用率和语音份额”

内容优化:

“我的网站引用的主要问题是什么,我如何改进我的答案?”

竞争性智能:

“比较我品牌的AI搜索性能与我的三大竞争对手”

使用您的品牌套件创建内容:

“写一篇关于附件文档中描述的产品的博客文章”

payload.name: Clarivate IPOne CM Trademarks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademark MCP helps teams search, review, and validate trademarks faster across global trademark registers. It combines broad jurisdiction coverage with flexible search options for mark names, phonetic variations, applicants, classes, goods and services, and filing details. Users can quickly assess result volumes, retrieve record details, access goods text, and open full-text records—making the server a strong fit for brand clearance, watch support, and trademark research workflows.
payload.longDescription: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademark MCP 可帮助团队在全球商标登记处更快地搜索、审查和验证商标。它结合了广泛的管辖范围覆盖,并为商标名称、语音变异、申请人、类、商品和服务以及提交细节提供灵活的搜索选项。

payload.name: Homesage.ai
payload.description: 查找和分析美国房地产
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.
payload.longDescription:
Homesage.ai 将 ChatGPT 变成一个房地产分析师,对 155 万美元以上的美国住宅房地产提供投资者级别的数据。 连接一次,然后用简单的语言询问估值,可比较的销售,租赁和翻转回报,翻新成本,所有者细节和完整的财产报告。

询问任何美国住宅地址,并获得房地产投资指标,自动估值(AVM),与修理后价值(ARV)的比较销售,以及人工智能评估的房地产状况,包括列表照片或自己的图像的分析。

对于投资者来说,Homesage.ai 计划固定回报,房间接房的翻新成本,以及长期和短期租赁经济学,如现金流、上限率、NOI和现金回报。

通过 ZIP 级销售数据和 Market Outlook 得分屏幕整个市场,或搜索国家财产数据库,使用投资者过滤器查找价格,状况,股权,紧急信号等。

额外的工具包括太阳能潜力和AI屋顶分析,抵押贷款和抵押贷款记录,预先关闭状态,位置风险旗帜,以及业主跳过追踪。

大多数分析工具从您的 Homesage.ai 帐户中消耗信用,每个工具的信用成本在其描述中列出。

Homesage.ai 读取财产数据并返回分析. 它不会修改您的帐户,转移资金,或代表您采取行动. 覆盖仅限于美国住宅财产,而可比较的销售和 ARV 数据仅限于非披露状态,销售价格不公开。

payload.name: august
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
august builds Digital Twins of the people your business needs to understand. Digital Twins are mirrors of your real users trained on your data to think, make decisions and respond like their real-life counterparts.

This plugin allows you signup for august and interact with your Digital Twins all from within ChatGPT or Codex.
payload.longDescription:
数字双胞胎是您在数据上训练的真实用户的镜子,以便他们像真实用户一样思考,做出决策和做出反应。

这个插件允许您注册8月,并与您的数字双胞胎从ChatGPT或Codex内部互动。

payload.name: AIDA Platform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIDA helps cinema and entertainment professionals analyze movies, theaters, showtimes, presales, box office results, historical occupancy, and audience forecasting. Ask questions in natural language to compare performance, track presale pace, review schedules, inspect realized market results, and combine signals across multiple data domains. Access depends on your organization's AIDA permissions.
payload.longDescription: AIDA帮助电影和娱乐专业人士分析电影,剧院,节目时间,预售,票房结果,历史占用率和观众预测。用自然语言提问,以比较性能,跟踪预售速度,审查时间表,检查实现的市场结果,并结合多个数据领域的信号。

payload.name: WitCloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WitCloud connects ChatGPT to your marketing, sales, and ecommerce data. Ask questions in plain language and get answers straight from your business data - explore customers, campaigns, revenue, and trends without writing SQL. WitCloud uses your business context to keep answers relevant. All access is read-only.
payload.longDescription: WitCloud 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销、销售和电子商务数据中。用简单的语言提问,并直接从您的业务数据中获得答案 - 探索客户、活动、收入和趋势,而不写 SQL。

payload.name: Influencers Club
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Influencers Club connects ChatGPT to creator data across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and OnlyFans. Ask in plain language — "find fitness creators on Instagram with 100k+ followers and 3%+ engagement" — and get back a ranked list you can act on.

The plugin provides 19 tools: creator discovery with semantic search and filters for followers, engagement, location, and language; profile enrichment including contact details, audience demographics, and past brand deals; recent posts with engagement metrics; audience-overlap comparison between creators; and lookalike search to find creators similar to one that already performs well.

Results come from the Influencers Club API and are billed against your account credits, appearing in your dashboard exactly as if you ran them there. Built for influencer marketers, agencies, talent managers, and founders doing campaign research, prospecting, and creator vetting.
payload.longDescription:
Influencers Club 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X、Twitch 和 OnlyFans 上的创作者数据中,用简单的语言来询问 - “在 Instagram 上找到拥有 100,000 名追随者和 3% 以上参与者的健身创作者” - 并获得您可以采取行动的排名列表。

该插件提供19个工具:创作者发现与语义搜索和粉丝,参与,位置和语言的过滤器;配置文件丰富包括联系信息,观众人口统计和过去的品牌交易;最近的帖子与参与指标;创作者之间的观众重叠比较;并寻找类似于已经表现良好的创作者。

结果来自 Influencers Club API,并对您的帐户发票,显示在您的仪表板上,就像您在那里运行它们一样。

payload.name: WaveMaster AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WaveMaster AI ajuda usuários e agentes a consultar previsões de surf, condições do mar e rankings de praias em mais de 916+ spots em 57 países e 6 continentes. O plugin permite buscar informações sobre ondas, vento, swell, maré, temperatura e score de surf diretamente no ChatGPT, com dados organizados para apoiar decisões rápidas sobre onde e quando surfar.
payload.longDescription: WaveMaster AI 帮助用户和代理商查询冲浪预测,海洋条件和海滩排名在 57 个国家和 6 个大洲的 916 多个地点. 该插件允许搜索有关波浪,风,潮汐,潮汐,温度和冲浪成绩的信息直接没有 ChatGPT,与组织的数据来支持冲浪的快速决定。

payload.name: Quanti IA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Quanti Analytics connects ChatGPT to your marketing data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), giving you instant access to cross-channel advertising data through natural language.

What you can do:

Ask questions about your marketing performance and get SQL queries generated from your actual table schemas — no hallucinated column names
Run read-only queries across 200+ connectors: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads, Shopify, Piano Analytics, and many more
Browse pre-built report catalogs to discover available metrics and dimensions for each connector
Save useful analyses as reusable templates, personal or shared with your team
Run Marketing Mix Modeling studies to measure each channel's real contribution to your KPI
How it works:

Connect your Quanti account via OAuth
ChatGPT retrieves your project's actual data schema — including semantic definitions of every metric and dimension
Ask your question in plain language, get accurate SQL, review it, and execute
Data access is strictly read-only. Quanti never modifies your data warehouse. Only projects and datasets you have permission to access are available.
payload.longDescription:
Quanti Analytics 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销数据仓库(BigQuery、Snowflake、Redshift),通过自然语言为您提供即时访问跨渠道广告数据。

你能做什么:

询问您的营销绩效,并从实际表格中生成的 SQL 查询 - 没有幻觉的列名 运行超过 200 个连接器的仅读查询:Google Ads,Meta,TikTok,Amazon Ads,Microsoft Ads,Shopify,Piano Analytics 和更多 浏览预建的报告目录以发现每个连接器的可用指标和尺寸 将有用的分析保存为可重复使用的模板,个人或与您的团队共享 运行营销组合建模研究来衡量每个渠道对您的 KPI 的实际贡献 如何工作:

通过 OAuth 连接您的 Quanti 帐户 ChatGPT 检索您的项目的实际数据架构 - 包括每个指标和维度的语义定义 用简单的语言提出您的问题,获得准确的 SQL,审查它,并执行数据访问仅限于阅读。

payload.name: Ezoic Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ezoic Analytics lets publishers explore their website analytics in ChatGPT. Ask questions about pageviews, visits, engagement, ad impressions, video performance, and revenue metrics like EPMV across your Ezoic domains. Break data down by date, page, country, device, traffic source, and dozens of other dimensions, with filtering and sorting — the same data that powers Ezoic's Big Data Analytics dashboard.

payload.name: Keenable SELECT
payload.description: 使用 SQL 研究 Web
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.
payload.longDescription:
Keenable SELECT 用一个查询来回答一个研究问题,而不是十页读取。

普通的网页搜索将链接列表交给模型,并将读取、提取和解复制留给模型。SELECT在搜索中执行此操作.该模型在 DuckDB 方言中编写一个只读的 SQL 语句;服务器在并行执行搜索,收集页面,用每行模型调用提取查询所要求的字段,删除复制并返回表。

一个查询可以覆盖超过一千个页面,无需额外费用将其过滤到普通的SQL中,并将其组合到答案中。

每个结果都被保存为一个结果设置为30天,所以下一个问题可以被问到相同的页面,而无需再次搜索. 一个完成的表可以作为一个HTML报告,图表和所有,在一个链接你可以交给某人。

它不是快速查看一页的工具:一个查询从秒到分钟运行,因为它真的搜索,收集和阅读。

请连接您的 Keenable 帐户一次以启用它. 搜索和收取该帐户的账单。
